title: Article on Combining Gouache and Watercolor
content: The new issue ofInternational Artistfeatures an article that I wrote about combining gouache and watercolor.I'll share some insights about watercolor and gouache formulation, tips for adding white, and information about reactivating colors in pans.There's a lot of helpful material in the new issue, including an article on the charcoal-portrait techniques of Nathan Fowkes.-----International Artist72 Tips for Sharing Art on Social MediaInternational Artist Magazine
